notes: QBTS is a quantum-annealing pure-play with NO specific Pentagon PE numbers or named DoD program-of-record claims in either the FY23 10-K or Q2-2024 10-Q. The filing acknowledges D-Wave Government Inc. exists as a federal contracting subsidiary, but no PE-tagged programs, no IDIQ ceilings, no obligated-to-date vs ceiling disclosures are made. Revenue narrative is overwhelmingly commercial (10-K: 'approximately 70 percent of FY23 revenue comes from commercial customers'). The closest J-Book-grounded language is the Davidson Technologies radar-scheduling co-development; no contract value, no PE number, no DoD prime program tied to it. Historic affiliations named (Lockheed Martin, Los Alamos, Oak Ridge, NASA QAIL, USC) are presented as research validation, not forward revenue. This means the J-Book divergence pattern (YSS/IONQ-style PE-zeroing) does NOT have load-bearing claims to attack in this filing. Score profile should therefore be heavy on UNVERIFIABLE / no J-Book hit, with a smaller set of MODERATE / PASS for the narrative-load-bearing commercial and DoD-adjacent claims. Most claims here are non-J-Book by necessity; we still surface the few DoD-adjacent claims for completeness.

ticker_pe_crosswalk.note: Crosswalk shows ZERO matched DoD PEs for QBTS — consistent with QBTS being a commercial-cloud-first quantum vendor whose federal exposure (if any) flows through small grants and sub-tier engagements, not prime PE-level contracts.
